free_tier_limits: Free nuget.org account; uploaded packages are limited to about 250 MB.
rate_limits: V3 search is currently not rate-limited. Package pushes are limited to 350/hour per API key; unlists are limited to 250/hour per API key.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Replace "unknown"; Microsoft documents free nuget.org accounts and an approximately 250 MB package-upload limit: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/nuget-org/publish-a-package#package-size-limits . rate_limits: Replace "not published"; Microsoft publishes no current V3 search limit, 350 pushes/hour/API key, and 250 unlists/hour/API key: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/api/rate-limits
